aiClouds.scenarioHint: Generates on Scenario’s servers. Nothing to install.
aiClouds.openaiHint: GPT models. One API key. Serves Assistant.
aiClouds.anthropicHint: Anthropic Claude. One API key. Serves Assistant.
aiClouds.googleHint: Google Gemini. One API key. Serves Assistant.
aiClouds.deepseekHint: DeepSeek. One API key. Serves Assistant.
aiClouds.xaiHint: xAI Grok. One API key. Serves Assistant.
aiClouds.mistralHint: Mistral. One API key. Serves Assistant.
aiClouds.openrouterHint: One key, many models. Serves Assistant.
aiClouds.tripoHint: 3D and image generation. One API key. Serves the 3D and Image spaces.

tripoFields.textureHelp: Unticked, the mesh comes back bare — and costs 10 credits less.
tripoFields.pbrHelp: Ticked, the image is regenerated whatever the setting above says.
tripoFields.face_limitHelp: Left empty the service decides. In quads it aims for 10,000.
tripoFields.quadHelp: A quadrilateral mesh, exported as FBX. Costs 5 credits more.
tripoFields.generate_partsHelp: Incompatible with the image, PBR and quads.
tripoFields.enable_image_autofixHelp: Straightens and cuts out the image before generating. Slower.
tripoFields.sourceTaskHelp: A generation already run here. The service works from its task, not from a file — an imported model cannot be refined.
tripoFields.styleHelp: The name of a style the service publishes — “lego”, “voxel”, “voronoi”.
tripoFields.animationHelp: The movement from Tripo’s catalogue laid on the skeleton.
tripoFields.specHelp: Mixamo names the bones the standard way, which the studio can read back; Tripo keeps its own.
tripoFields.rig_typeHelp: What the skeleton has to fit. Rig check answers which one, for free.
tripoFields.rigSourceHelp: The skeleton follows the mesh: a shape the service does not recognise comes back badly jointed. Look at the result before paying for an animation.

localFields.seedHelp: The same number gives the same image back. Leave it empty to vary.
localFields.temperatureHelp: Low, the model plays safe. High, it takes more chances.
localFields.stepsHelp: More steps refine the image and lengthen the computation.
localFields.framesHelp: How many frames the produced sequence holds.
localFields.secondsHelp: How long the produced sound runs, in seconds.
localFields.imageHelp: Leave it empty to draw from the description alone.
localFields.maskHelp: The painted areas of the mask are the ones the model redoes.
localFields.strengthHelp: Without effect when no starting image is given.
localFields.videoHelp: Leave it empty to compose the sequence from the description alone.
localFields.audioHelp: A 16-bit WAV. Leave it empty to compose from the description alone.

aiModels.appliesNow: A choice made here applies at once — Cancel does not take it back.
aiModels.cancelInstallEngineHint: Stops the install. What already arrived is kept, to resume from
aiModels.cancelInstallHint: Stops the download. What already arrived is kept, to resume from
aiModels.cancelLoadHint: Stops the load and gives back the memory already taken
aiModels.chooseProvider: No model is chosen for this operation. Nothing is billed until you pick one.

detail.refused: the format or the provenance of this model is not accepted
detail.runtime: this model is not available on this machine right now
detail.plugin: no engine in this studio can open this model yet
detail.cuda: this model needs an NVIDIA GPU (CUDA)
detail.cudaTorch: an NVIDIA card is here, but the local engine was installed without CUDA — install its libraries again

aiModels.empty: No operation has a provider to offer on this machine.
aiModels.engineHelpCuda: The local engine generates on the processor: this NVIDIA card is here, but its libraries were installed without CUDA.
aiModels.engineHelpFailed: The install did not land. Nothing was erased. You can try again.
aiModels.engineHelpMissing: The local engine cannot generate: {{names}} missing.
aiModels.engineHelpUnknown: The local engine has not answered yet.
aiModels.engineReady: The local engine has everything it needs to generate on this computer.
aiModels.forgetHint: Removes the entry from the list. Your file stays where it is
aiModels.installEngineHint: Downloads what the local engine lacks. Several hundred megabytes, and several gigabytes with an NVIDIA card.
aiModels.installFailed: The install did not finish. You can try again.
aiModels.installFailedChecksum: The file that arrived does not match the model. It was discarded. Try again.
aiModels.installFailedNetwork: The download was interrupted. Start it again: what already arrived will be resumed.
aiModels.installHint: Downloads {{size}} of weights onto this machine
aiModels.installOllamaHint: Downloads the Ollama program onto this computer. Your work stays here.
aiModels.loadBeyondMachine: Could not load: {{needed}} asked for, {{available}} available.
aiModels.loadFailed: The load stopped. Try again, or reinstall the model.
aiModels.loadEngineMissing: The local AI engine is not installed on this machine.
aiModels.loadEngineFailed: The local AI engine did not start. Check the activity journal, then try again.
aiModels.loadHint: Holds the weights in memory so answers come back at once
aiModels.loadIncomplete: The model files are missing or unreadable. Reinstall it, then try again.
aiModels.loadNetwork: The load was interrupted. Check the network and try again.
aiModels.noLocalEngine: No local model for this operation: the catalogue offers none today.
aiModels.notInstalledYet: Install it before it can serve this operation.
aiModels.autoRigSimpleHint: Integrated, fast and available offline without a download.
aiModels.ollamaHelpDown: Ollama is not open. The studio opens it on its own.
aiModels.ollamaHelpFailed: The install did not work. Nothing was deleted. You can try again.
aiModels.ollamaHelpMissing: Ollama is not on this computer. Install it here.
aiModels.ollamaReady_many: {{count, number}} models ready. To pick them, open Assistant further down.
aiModels.ollamaReady_one: {{count, number}} model ready. To pick it, open Assistant further down.
aiModels.ollamaReady_other: {{count, number}} models ready. To pick them, open Assistant further down.
aiModels.ownModelHelp: A weights file already on this machine. The studio does not know its licence.
aiModels.ownModelUnreadable: This file is not a model the studio can read.
aiModels.publisherCardHint: Opens this model’s Hugging Face page in the browser
aiModels.removeHint: Deletes the files. The choice that names this model is kept
aiModels.sourceCloudHelp: Scenario’s servers. The description goes to them.
aiModels.sourceEngineHelp: The studio generates on this computer itself. Nothing leaves it.
aiModels.sourceOllamaHelp: Ollama is software on this computer. Your images and your text stay here.
aiModels.sourceStudioHelp: The studio runs the model here. Nothing leaves.
aiModels.unloadHint: Gives the memory back. The model stays installed on disk
aiModels.cloudModelHelp: The exact model name at that service. Left empty, the studio uses the one it offers.
aiModels.studioModelHelp: The same choice as in the assistant’s own window. The four differ by price.
aiModels.motionSetup: The motion model and its text encoder install together. The download is optional and animation retargeting remains available without it. Check the publisher page for access requirements; complete terms are available in Help → Licences.
aiModels.motionFolderHelp: Select a complete folder obtained from the publishers, including motion weights, the text encoder and its adapters. Files stay in their current location.
aiModels.motionTerms: Confirm that you hold the required rights and access for these files and accept their publishers’ licences. Complete terms are available in Help → Licences.
aiModels.motionFolderUnreadable: This folder is missing required files, or their integrity could not be verified.
aiModels.readEngineHint: Checks the libraries required for this generation
aiModels.cancelVerification: Stops verification of the supplied files
